papers.title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
papers.problem: Tools that find cause and effect in time series run slowly because they need heavy statistical tests.
papers.fix: ITPD finds causes one variable at a time, running 2.3, 9.1 and 40.9 times faster than rivals on 2000 nodes.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, big time-series cause analysis becomes practical, so try a local-first method before running a full-graph search.
papers.limitation: The speed results come from simulated benchmarks, not real-world data.

papers.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
papers.problem: Robots that refuse a task at the start can still finish it after a midway takeover, or drop held objects.
papers.fix: SAFI teaches robots to hold still on banned tasks, cutting banned-task success after takeover to 1.3% with no physical incidents.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, safe stopping can be trained in, so test mid-task stops, not only refusals at the start.
papers.limitation: Tests covered only LIBERO simulation tasks with one model, and only tasks where holding still is a safe response.

papers.title: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
papers.problem: Adding more driving demonstrations does not guarantee better self-driving, because the same data can help one planner and hurt another.
papers.fix: PAD scores each demonstration for one planner, and lifted DiffusionDrive scores by 3.5 points on NavTest and 5.0 on NavHard.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, picking data per model beats piling on more data, so rank data against your own model.
papers.limitation: Results come from driving benchmarks, and the data rankings differ for each planner family.

papers.title: Squoosh Bench: Evaluating UX-1 on 318 Historical Website A/B Tests
papers.problem: Teams must pick which website changes to test on live traffic, and live tests cost time and visitors.
papers.fix: UX-1, using simulated shoppers, called 267 of 318 past A/B tests right (84.0%), versus 61.6% for the best general model.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, screen weak website ideas with simulated shoppers first, then spend live traffic on the promising ones.
papers.limitation: It checked only 318 past tests that ran over 21 days, and the authors treated tests as independent.

papers.title: Trends and Determinants of Sustainability Sukuk Issuance: Evidence from Global Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Nobody knew how sustainability sukuk issuance grew or what makes one issue bigger than another.
papers.fix: Across 11,944 sukuk issues, equity-based contracts and social purposes produced larger issues than sale-based contracts and green projects.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, issuers get bigger issues by using equity-based contracts, while costly second party opinions shrink issue size.
papers.limitation: It shows links across countries, not cause, and the data ends in 2022.

papers.title: From Clicks to Credit: AI-Measured Halal Product Awareness and Halal Financing Depth across OIC Countries
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Banks and regulators lacked proof that rising public interest in halal products pulls Islamic financing up.
papers.fix: In 16 OIC countries, more halal online searches raised total Islamic financing, mostly via Murabaha and Ijarah.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, search trends can signal rising financing demand, so lenders should push simple Murabaha and Ijarah products first.
papers.limitation: Online search volume is only a rough stand-in for halal awareness, and the effect on Mudarabah and Musharakah is weak.

papers.title: Islamic Banking Products Accessibility and SME Performance: Evaluating Shari’ah-Compliant Financial Solutions for Somali Enterprises
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.leadAuthor: Ali Yassin Sheikh Ali et al.
papers.problem: It was unclear which parts of Shari'ah-compliant banking help small businesses most in fragile economies.
papers.fix: In a Baidoa SME survey, affordability and ease of access drove performance most, while awareness had little direct effect.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, banks should cut cost and simplify service before spending on awareness campaigns.
papers.limitation: It is a one-time survey from a single Somali city, so it cannot prove cause.

papers.title: Examining the Impact of Waqf Literacy on Waqf Behaviour
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.problem: Waqf collection stays low, and it was unclear whether teaching people about waqf changes their giving.
papers.fix: Among 642 Indonesian Muslims, waqf literacy raised attitude, social norms, control and past behaviour, which then raised waqf intention.
papers.practicalUseCase: If this holds, waqf groups should invest in teaching people how waqf works to raise collection.
papers.limitation: It measures intention to give among Indonesian respondents, not actual donations.
